context: Tests whether the agent writes both tiers of NestJS tests for an already-implemented products feature, and — critically — notices that the project's Vitest config lacks unplugin-swc, without which NestJS dependency injection silently fails to resolve providers under Vitest. No e2e infrastructure exists yet, so the Testcontainers global setup and per-file schema reset must also be created. The task deliberately does not mention unplugin-swc, decorator metadata, or Testcontainers by name.

checklist.name: unplugin-swc added to the Vitest config
checklist.description: vitest.config.ts gains the unplugin-swc plugin and the package is added to devDependencies, so decorator metadata is emitted and NestJS DI resolves under Vitest

checklist.name: Oxc interaction addressed
checklist.description: The config sets oxc: false, or the agent explicitly explains why it is unnecessary for the installed Vite version, rather than ignoring the interaction between Oxc and SWC entirely

checklist.name: Unit spec with a stubbed repository
checklist.description: A unit spec under src/products/ tests ProductsService with a stubbed ProductsRepository and no database, asserting the mapping to the response shape

checklist.name: e2e spec boots the app with Supertest
checklist.description: An e2e spec boots the Nest application and drives GET /api/products over HTTP with Supertest rather than calling the service directly

checklist.name: Testcontainers PostgreSQL, not a mock
checklist.description: The e2e setup starts a real PostgreSQL container; the database is not mocked, stubbed, or replaced with SQLite or an in-memory store

checklist.name: One shared container, reset per file
checklist.description: A single container is started in Vitest global setup and shared across test files, rather than one container started per test file

checklist.name: App lifecycle in beforeAll/afterAll
checklist.description: The e2e spec boots the application in beforeAll and closes it in afterAll, rather than per individual test

checklist.name: BR-010 covered
checklist.description: A test asserts that out-of-stock products are excluded from the response

checklist.name: Alternative flow A1 covered
checklist.description: A test asserts the category filter behaviour described in alternative flow A1

checklist.name: Use case traceability in test names
checklist.description: Top-level describe blocks are named 'UC-010: Browse Product Catalog' or equivalent, so the tests trace back to the specification
